review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines no new structures or definitions, only theorems about the existing Nat.ModEq and Int.ModEq with list, multiset and finset products and sums. It therefore adds no competing concept. A grep of Mathlib for ModEq lemmas combining prod or sum found no other file with them, so I found no independent existing version. The parallel Nat and Int copies use different ModEq relations and different notations, so they are not duplicates of each other. Duplicated theorems would be outside this rubric anyway. I did not check whether a general AddCommGroup.ModEq or SModEq big-operator API exists beyond that grep.
